qualification: code audit, checkpoint-free synthetic screens, and an independent unwired tracer primitive; no real model was loaded and no formal performance run was executed

synthetic_screen.warning: These short screens use deterministic synthetic matrices with production shapes on a noisy host. They rank slices; they are not model or formal benchmark evidence.

a_gdn_projections_only.assessment: Only projection option with a material signal, but two CPU-interposed waits per layer leave much of the gain on the table.

b_full_attention_projections_only.assessment: At production shapes W8 Metal and F32 Accelerate are effectively tied; reject as the next isolated slice.

c_transfer_and_wait_compression.assessment: Memcpy reduction is immaterial. Wait compression is valuable but cannot be performed independently because CPU attention is a strict dependency between every MLP block.

d_full_model_resident.assessment: Correct long-term architecture and required to close the gap to MLX, but too broad for the next tracer.

selected_tracer.name: one decode-only resident Metal W8 GDN attention block
selected_tracer.scope: One selected linear-attention layer: fused q/k/v/z/a/b W8 input projection, depthwise convolution, SiLU/L2 preprocessing, transactional recurrent update, output RMSNorm and z gate, then W8 output projection in one command buffer. The existing CPU residual/post-norm and Metal MLP block remain unchanged.
selected_tracer.why_smallest_valid: The existing generic W8 matvec proves the two dense endpoints. Fusing the recurrent middle changes two waits into one and makes state resident; a projection-only route adds 36 waits, while a full layer or full model expands scope unnecessarily.

per_layer_storage.qualification: deterministic buffer payload; excludes Metal pipeline, queue, object, and allocator overhead

correctness_gates: Decode-only: sequence length must be one and start_pos must be positive; prefill stays CPU.
CPU W8 projection reference and CPU F32 GDN oracle compare all intermediate tensors with declared finite tolerances.
Prefill state seed verifies conv suffixes and the canonical [16,128,128] recurrent layout.
Recurrent and convolution state use committed/scratch buffers; swap only after command completion, fail closed, and never CPU-retry a possibly mutated state.
One-layer teacher-forced token gate first; then selected-layer call receipts, 128-token teacher exactness, and six 128-token free-run trajectories before replication.
All-18 replication requires zero process swaps, RSS below 6 GiB, and a quiet-host positive-pair performance gate.

directional_performance.required_candidate_admission: At least 10% median end-to-end TPOT improvement with every paired run positive; otherwise stop and do not replicate.
